body: It is the time in your life when you simultaneously know everything and nothing at an instance?
It is the transportation of choice for princesses to attend balls?
It is where everyone wants to run home and stealing is encouraged?
It is where kings, queens, knights and bishops go to war together?
It is yellow and you can serve it but not eat?
It keeps something that cannot be kept and wakes you when you’ve slept. It may go slow or stop at times but even then it chimes?
It keeps things green and keeps the kids occupied in the summertime?
It keeps you on the ground and stops things from floating around. What is it?
It may only be given, Not taken or bought, What the sinner desires but the saint does not?
It may only be given, not taken or bought. What the sinner desires but the saint does not. What is it?
It moves around in circles. We see it as we turn. It keeps us always warm. Always alive and always dying, Across the sky we see it flying but touch it and we burn?
It occurs once in every minute. Twice in every moment and yet never in one hundred thousand years?

It passes but you never hear it. Sometimes though, you think you feel it. You think you had it but it’s gone. You want to stop it but it moves on. You lose it, gain it, maybe fear it but it goes on, forever on?
It regulates our daily movements but it feels no interest in our lives. It directs us when to come and go but does not care if we pay attention. What is it?
It rows quickly with four oars but never comes out from under his own roof. What is it?
It runs all day and night but it still doesn’t get hot or tired. What is it?

It sat upon a willow tree and sang softly unto me. Easing my pain and sorrow with its song. I wished to fly but tarried long. And in my suffering, the willow was like a cool clear spring. What was it that helped me so? To spend my time in my woe?
It speaks to you, yet it can’t speak. When you hold it you can travel, in your mind’s eye worlds unravel. And everything in it’s a lie. And with every new untruth, still you feel it speaks the truth?
It speaks without a tongue and listens without ears?
It stalks the countryside with ears that can’t hear. What is it?
it stand on one leg and have my heart in my head?
It stands on one leg with its heart in its head?
It stands on one leg with its heart in its head. What is it?
It stands upright and can be quite grand. Its secret is not hidden but right at hand. What is it?
It starts at the earth’s end and brink, Filled with water you can’t drink. Has a color, just like ink, Walk into it and you’ll sink?
It starts with T, ends with T and is full of T. What is it?
It takes two people to do this?
It walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon and three legs in the evening. What is it?

It was a tradition long ago, When the world was dark and full of woe. When men turned darkness into light, By mixing, melting and decanting in the night, To seek for youth and gold and riches, Just to be burned as witches?
It was fully armed and operational when Lando attacked in Han's spaceship?
It will not die when hung and will dry when wrung?
It’s a symbol and a fruit, For man’s folly, evil’s root. But also for great inspiration and famous application?
It's always above the negatives Yet it's lower than the first prime no matter how you multiply it's the same every time?
It's anything but amusing when this body part gets hit?
It's been around For millions of years but it's no more Than a month old?
It's been around for millions of years but it's no more than a month old. What is it?
It's been around for millions of years but its no more than a month old?
It's equally comfortable in an orchestra and a geometry textbook. What is it?
It's held in the hand When going out?
It's in the church but not in the steeple; It's in the parson but not in the people; It's in the oyster but not in the shell; It's in the clapper but not in the bell?
It's in your hand though you can not feel it. Only you and time can reveal it?

It’s like a forrest without trees, Like a jail you want to visit. Though the inmates did no wrong. You may freely walk along, They’re put there so you can see them, Just as long as you don’t feed them?
It’s raining at midnight but the forecast for tomorrow and the next day is clear. Will there be sunny weather in 48 hours?
answer: No, it won’t be sunny because it will be dark out. In 48 hours, it will be midnight again.

body: It's red, blue, purple and green, no one can reach it, not even the queen?

It’s round but also like a chess-board. It can and is both whirled and curled and bent and shot and parried. Some play it on a field or watch it on the couch and anyone can play it, even Peter Crouch?
It's shorter than the rest but when you're happy, you raise it up like it's the best. What is it?
It’s small but larger than a bee and agile as a flea. It humms but does not buzz and it’s not covered with fuzz. It is a small collector, Of juicy flower nectar?
It’s the only place in the world where today comes before yesterday. Where is it?
It's the only vegetable or fruit that is never sold frozen, canned, processed, cooked, or in any other form but fresh?
It’s tough as nails, Or soft as snow. People use it for their rink, Some just put in their drink?
